about: Regular (non-HDHP) plans whose brochure states the per-person (embedded) deductible rule the app applies to them: each person meets their own Self Only deductible until the family's deductible spending together reaches the family deductible. The list is the 60 plan codes in docs/research/2027-family-rules-from-brochures.md (summary row 'Brochure confirms per-person (embedded), and the app assumes embedded'), with the brochure and page from that document's per-brochure table; where a table row covers several options and its quote names another option's amount (424, KC1, AM1, N41, 254, PS4), the quote is that option's own sentence on the same page, and the Value Plan codes of 73-879 use its p16 sentence. pipeline/build_data.py attaches each entry as benefits[year][plan_code]['deductible_rule_source'] ({brochure, page, quote}) and checks that the plan is not a high-deductible plan, the year is an integer, the quote is a string under 15 words and occurs on the named brochure page. The board's 'Deductible type' row says '(brochure)' for these plans and '(assumed)' for every other embedded plan (e.g. WJ4, AS1 and GG4, whose brochures do not state it: GG4's 73-849 p24 gives $350 per person under Self Only enrollment only and a combined $700 for family enrollments).
